facts.fact: The Gambia's Personal Data Protection and Privacy Act, 2025 (Act No. 11 of 2025, assented 7 November 2025) names the Information Commission established under the Access to Information Act as the Commission, with Part 8 on its functions, powers and fines.
The Personal Data Protection and Privacy Act, 2025 (Act No. 11 of 2025) was assented to by the President on 7 November 2025; the excerpt shows no commencement provision.
facts.system: Personal Data Protection and Privacy Act, 2025

facts.fact: The Act names the Information Commission established under the Access to Information Act as its supervisory Commission, in Part 8.

GMB.note: The Act is assented with no commencement stated and the document does not say whether the Commission is appointed or whether the law is in force.
